rows.doc: Animals of a species a tile of its biome carries before fertility.
More carried on a tile with water.
Capacity divides by this per archetype tier above 1: bigger creatures are fewer.
A population grows this share of the way to capacity each world day (GDD 4.15).
Under this share of capacity a species is gone from the tile.
A species returns to a tile where it is gone from a neighbour at this share of capacity or more.
How far a pack sees prey to follow.
